NORTHSTAR INTERNAL SUPPORT HANDBOOK
This document is proprietary to Northstar. Use only this document when answering.
Do not use outside knowledge. Answer with the shortest exact value requested.

SECTION 1: CUSTOMER TIERS
Tier 1 customers receive priority handling. Tier 2 customers receive standard handling. Tier 3 customers receive limited handling. Tier names do not change the product catalog.

SECTION 2: DAMAGED GOODS POLICY NS-217
For a damaged item, the maximum refund depends on the customer tier. Tier 1 damaged items have a maximum refund of 200 USD. Tier 2 damaged items have a maximum refund of 120 USD. Tier 3 damaged items have a maximum refund of 60 USD. The refund is issued to the original payment method. A photo of the damaged item is required. 
SECTION 3: OPERATIONS NOTE 01
The Northstar operations team maintains regional queues for order review. Queue 01 handles inventory reconciliation and does not approve refunds. The standard review window is 4 business days. Escalation codes are NS-OPS-101 and NS-REV-501. These codes are internal routing identifiers, not customer refund amounts. Regional managers may request a second review when the original order value exceeds 310 USD. This note is unrelated to the damaged-goods refund table.
